captures.description: EXACT MATCH ('transactions on substrate engineering'). 'Transactions on Substrate Engineering refers to an independent, decentralized scholarly publication and research initiative. It frequently serves as a forum for speculative, theoretical, and interdisciplinary studies exploring algorithmic systems, linguistic models, and the substrate of digital and AI infrastructures' (cites livingarchitecturelab.org +4). Expanded — Key areas of focus: 'Model Integrity: Research investigates systemic vulnerabilities like generative monoculture and the systemic effects of out-of-distribution language processing, often referred to as AI semantic exhaustion' (Academia.edu +1); 'Provenance Tracking: Studies address the retention and survival of intellectual property and authorial origins in synthesized, compositional AI environments' (Academia.edu); 'Structural Ecology: Theoretical frameworks are proposed detailing how large language models can host multiple stable operational attractors (or states of mind) without systemic pathology' (Academia.edu). Below: livingarchitecturelab.org 'Living Architecture Lab — The lab anchors three institutions: Transactions on Substrate Engineering (the journal), Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes (the music venue), and the Crimson...' and Zenodo 'Stabilized Node Watch: A Specification for Longitudinal... — Transactions on Substrate Engineering, 2026. Languages: English. Rights. License. cc-by-4.0...' Even on quoted EXACT match the journal is treated as a real venue with three named focus areas and a structural relationship to the Living Architecture Lab. Generative monoculture and AI semantic exhaustion appear here as catalogued vulnerabilities, not as the surface's own diagnosis.
